Script.name: Icesus-Loader
Script.script:
function downloadPackage(a,b) decho("<0,150,190>[ INFO ] - <0,160,0>Downloading the Icesus Mudlet package...\n") downloadFile(getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Icesus.mpackage", "https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package/releases/latest/download/Icesus.mpackage") end
function installReady(event, file) if file ~= getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage" then return end if not io.exists(getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage") then decho([[<0,150,190>[ INFO ] - <0,160,0>To install the Icesus Mudlet package, copy the following text (without line breaks) into the input line and send it:
lua function d(a,b)if not b:find("Icesus",1,true)then return end installPackage(b)os.remove(b)cecho("<gold>Package installed!\n")end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone","d")downloadFile(getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage","https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package/releases/latest/download/Icesus.mpackage")
]]) return end
decho("<0,160,0>[ OK ] - <190,100,50>The Icesus Mudlet package was downloaded successfully.\n") decho("<0,150,190>[ INFO ] - <0,160,0>Installing... (this takes a few seconds.)\n") tempTimer(1, [[installPackage(getMudletHomeDir().."/Icesus.mpackage")]]) uninstallPackage("icesus-loader") end
registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "downloadPackage") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", "installReady")
